privacy.headline: Privacy, in clear terms.
body: This notice describes the Broom Home Enterprises LLC review website. Contact info@broomhome.biz with questions about your information. Final retention periods and applicable privacy rights require business confirmation before public launch.
The inquiry form is disabled. It does not submit or store the information you type. No inquiry email is sent by this preview. Please contact the business directly by phone or email.

Phone and email links open your own applications. Information you choose to share is handled by your communications provider and the business to respond to your inquiry. Do not send account numbers, payment credentials, identification documents or sensitive financial information.
Myndy live chat is not active. No Myndy script is loaded and no conversation is sent to Myndy from this preview. A revised notice and separate approval are required before activation.

The website host may process IP addresses, request information and technical logs to deliver and protect the website. No separate marketing analytics, advertising tags or payment processing have been added to this customer experience.
Photographs are licensed illustrative stock images. They do not identify Broom Home properties, available listings, customers or team members.
